name: Maré do Amor
source:
Something's wrong with the water. The rats know it. The Guru whispers it. Now you're beginning to feel it too...

[From [url=https://virgula.itch.io/maredoamor]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
水里有些不对劲。老鼠心知肚明，导师低语示警，如今就连你也开始察觉到了异样……

[摘自[url=https://virgula.itch.io/maredoamor]itch.io[/url]]
